\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch8:8-25↗ prob:product-metric-curvature For $i = 1,2$, suppose $(M_i, g_i)$ is a Riemannian manifold of dimension $n_i \ge 2$ with constant sectional curvature $c_i$; and let $g = g_1 \oplus g_2$ be the product metric on $M = M_1 \times M_2$. Show that the Weyl tensor of $g$ is given by \[ W = \frac{c_1 + c_2}{2(n-1)(n-2)} \left( n_2(n_2-1)h_1 \owedge h_1 - 2(n_1-1)(n_2-1)h_1 \owedge h_2 + n_1(n_1-1)h_2 \owedge h_2 \right), \] where $n = n_1 + n_2$ and $h_i = \pi _i^* g_i$ for $i = 1,2$. Conclude that $(M,g)$ is locally conformally flat if and only if $c_2 = -c_1$. (See also Problem 7-6.)

(Used on p. 67.) \end{exercise}
